title: Massaman Vegetable Curry with Flatbread
description: A flavorful and aromatic Massaman curry made with roasted vegetables, served with crispy flatbread.

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables (such as carrots, bell peppers, and onions)

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add Massaman curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add roasted vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, warm flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
To serve, place a piece of flatbread on a plate and top with a spoonful of the Massaman curry.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
